title: Show HN: Find someone in the dark – light them or light yourself? (Three.js)
summary: A Three.js-based interactive 3D experience exploring the concept of light and shadow in darkness, presenting a visual choice between illuminating others or illuminating oneself.
problem_solved: Creates an interactive 3D visualization demonstrating light and shadow dynamics in dark environments.
why_valuable: Provides an artistic and interactive WebGL demo that explores a philosophical/visual concept through real-time 3D rendering.
